title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 136 ]

blocks.text: Poetry moves us to sympathize with the emotions of the poet himself
or with those of the persons whom his imagination has created. We
witness their struggles, triumphs and failures. We feel their loves and
losses, joys and sorrows, hopes and fears, somewhat as if they were
our own. Though we sometimes suffer along with their anxieties and
sorrows, we receive a pleasure from the experience. Poetry provides
us with what is missing in our own lives - the experience of
imaginative pleasure. That is why we appreciate poetry in everyday

readingSentences.english: Poetry moves us to sympathize with the emotions of the poet himself or with those of the persons whom his imagination has created.
readingSentences.korean: 시란 우리를 감동시켜서 시인의 감정이나 시인의 상상력이 창조해 낸 사람들(작중 인물)의 정서에 동감하도록 한다.

readingSentences.english: We witness their struggles, triumphs and failures.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 그들의 투쟁과 승리와 실패를 목격한다.

readingSentences.english: We feel their loves and losses, joys and sorrows, hopes and fears, somewhat as if they were our own.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 그들의 사랑과 상실, 기쁨과 슬픔, 희망과 공포들을, 그 것들이 마치 우리들의 것인냥 느낀다.

readingSentences.english: Though we sometimes suffer along with their anxieties and sorrows, we receive a pleasure from the experience.
readingSentences.korean: 종종 우리가 그들의 걱정과 슬픔을 함께 겪기도 하지만, 그런 경험으로부터 우린 기쁨도 얻는다.

readingSentences.english: Poetry provides us with what is missing in our own lives - the experience of imaginative pleasure.
readingSentences.korean: 시란 우리의 삶에서 우리가 놓치고 있는 것을 우리에게 제공한다.

readingSentences.english: That is why we appreciate poetry in everyday life.
readingSentences.korean: 그게 바로 일상 생활 속에서 우리가 시를 감상하는 이유이다.
